findings.defect: 깝치지 말고 means not to act up or get carried away; “showing off” narrows it to displaying oneself and changes the instruction’s tone.
findings.rationale: The source tells Mujin not to 깝치다 before telling him to remain there. It does not specifically refer to showing off.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor shift in Mujin’s instruction to stay behind.
